State callbacks to phone UI. 2026-05-16

features.name: AGC + adaptive bitrate + latency measurement
features.nameZh: 自动增益 + 自适应码率 + 延迟测量
features.description: Browser-side AGC via Web Audio API DynamicsCompressorNode. Adaptive bitrate: <50ms → 64kbps, >=50ms → 32kbps (5s debounce). E2E latency via ping/pong round-trip, displayed on dashboard and phone stats.
features.descriptionZh: 浏览器端 Web Audio API DynamicsCompressorNode 实现 AGC。自适应码率：延迟<50ms→64kbps，>=50ms→32kbps（5秒冷却）。ping/pong 往返测端到端延迟，仪表盘和手机端均显示
features.evidence: AGC: DynamicsCompressorNode (-50dB/12:1/3ms) between getUserMedia and AudioEncoder. Adaptive bitrate switches on latency threshold with debounce. Latency: ping every 2s, server relays pong, phone calculates RTT/2, dashboard 4th metric shows one-way ms. E2E verified 2026-05-16.

features.name: WebRTC P2P transport (optional)
features.description: Replace AudioEncoder + WS with RTCPeerConnection for lower latency. Phone sends MediaStreamTrack directly. Server uses werift (TS WebRTC) to receive. Keep WS for signaling only. Re-evaluated 2026-11-14: demoted to a decision gate inside F-013 — only implement if measured end-to-end latency stays >100ms after buffer/encoding tuning. Still compatible with the browser-only constraint (WebRTC is a browser capability).
features.descriptionZh: 将 AudioEncoder + WebSocket 替换为 RTCPeerConnection 以降低延迟。手机直接发送 MediaStreamTrack，服务端通过 werift 接收，WebSocket 仅用于信令。2026-11-14 重评估：降级为 F-013 内的决策门——缓冲/编码调优后实测端到端延迟仍 >100ms 才实施。与手机零安装约束兼容（WebRTC 是浏览器能力）

features.name: Stability hardening: silent failures + config.json + unit tests
features.nameZh: 稳定性收口：静默失败修复 + config.json + 单元测试
features.description: Phase 0 of the 2026-11-14 roadmap. 1) Surface silent failure paths: opus decode failures logged (rate-limited) with summary at close; waveOutPrepareHeader/Write failures logged with MMRESULT; file pipe gets closed guard + error state broadcast. 2) config.json support (port, audioPipeMode, initialBitrate) with env-var precedence, validated with warnings — replaces the unsafe 'as AudioPipeMode' cast. 3) Minimal vitest suite: pipe factory dispatch, opus decode behavior, PcmChunker buffer/starvation logic, config loading. Remaining sub-item: real-machine verification of the BUG-001 fix (needs Windows exe + phone).
features.descriptionZh: 2026-11-14 路线图 Phase 0。1) 修复静默失败路径：opus 解码失败限频记录并在关闭时汇总；waveOutPrepareHeader/Write 失败记录 MMRESULT；file 模式补 closed guard + 错误状态广播。2) config.json 支持（port、audioPipeMode、initialBitrate），环境变量优先，无效值警告回退——替换不安全的 'as AudioPipeMode' 强转。3) 最小 vitest 测试套件：pipe 工厂分发、opus 解码行为、PcmChunker 缓冲/饥饿裁剪逻辑、config 加载。剩余子项：BUG-001 修复的真机验证（需 Windows exe + 手机）
features.evidence: Automated: vitest 24/24 pass (test/audio-pipe.test.ts, test/wasapi-chunker.test.ts, test/config.test.ts); typecheck + build clean; ./init.sh full pass (2026-11-14); runtime smoke test: config.json loaded (port 3199/audioPipeMode file/initialBitrate 48000 all effective), invalid env value warned. Remaining: BUG-001 real-machine E2E — user to run release exe, phone stop → uptime freezes + audio closes (tracked in progress.md BUG-001).

features.name: Phone reliability: Wake Lock + PWA + reconnect hardening
features.nameZh: 手机端可靠性：Wake Lock + PWA + 重连强化
features.description: Phase 2 of the 2026-11-14 roadmap — core to the zero-install promise. Screen Wake Lock API while streaming (release on stop, re-acquire on visibilitychange). Verify lock-screen/background behavior on real devices and record findings. PWA: manifest + service worker for add-to-home-screen full-screen operation. Reconnect hardening: immediate reconnect on visibilitychange/online events (skip backoff), auto-resume capture after recovery.
features.descriptionZh: 2026-11-14 路线图 Phase 2——零安装承诺的核心。采集期间申请 Screen Wake Lock（停止释放、页面可见时重新申请）。真机验证锁屏/后台行为并记录结论。PWA：manifest + service worker，支持添加到主屏幕全屏运行。重连强化：visibilitychange/online 事件触发立即重连（跳过退避计时），恢复后自动续采
features.evidence: Implemented + emulator-verified + QAInspector CONDITIONAL_PASS→fixed (2026-11-14, decisions D-007/D-008). (1) Reconnect hardening: killed server mid-stream → client showed 'Reconnecting in 30s... (7/10)'; server restored + HOME→foreground → new connection + streaming resumed within ~2-5s (vs the pending 30s backoff tick) — visibilitychange path proven; 'online' event wired through the same forceReconnectNow. QAInspector headless double-check: online dispatched mid-backoff → attempt within 300ms, guard does not fire while OPEN. (2) Wake Lock: SCREEN_BRIGHT_WAKE_LOCK held during streaming, gone after Stop — BUT this lock is Chromium's capture path; the client.js wakeLock code path has never executed in a real secure context (API absent under self-signed cert) — PENDING_REAL_DEVICE_TEST. (3) PWA: manifest + sw.js + generated icons (scripts/gen-icons.mjs, pure-Node PNG writer) served correctly; SW offline shell verified 12/12 checks by QAInspector on headless Chrome with trusted TLS (macOS) — code correct; blocked under self-signed cert (D-008). (4) QAInspector findings fixed in-session: P1 CLOSING-race reconnect storm (old ws handlers detached + closed in connectAndStream), P2 res.ok cache guards + pc.html favicon + wakeLock in-flight guard + e2e script exec-fix (no leaked port after exit). E2E regression PASS ×3 (1880, 1930, 1385 chunks); vitest 24/24. PENDING_REAL_DEVICE_TEST items: lock-screen/background capture continuity, real-network reconnect timing, PWA install flow, Wake Lock API on a trusted-cert device.

features.name: Browser-side audio DSP
features.description: Phase 3 of the 2026-11-14 roadmap — all phone-side, browser capability only. Mic device selection (enumerateDevices + deviceId constraint with stale-device fallback). EQ via BiquadFilter chain (fixed 80Hz highpass cut + adjustable lowshelf/highshelf) after AGC, before encoding. Noise gate via AudioWorklet (RMS + 250ms hold, adjustable threshold). Level meter via AnalyserNode shown on phone + broadcast to dashboard every 500ms. Settings panel persisted in localStorage (echo-cancellation/AGC/EQ/gate toggles + slider values, sanitized on load).
features.descriptionZh: 2026-11-14 路线图 Phase 3——全部手机端，仅浏览器能力。麦克风设备选择（enumerateDevices + applyConstraints）。EQ：BiquadFilter 链（80Hz 低切 + 可调 lowshelf/peaking/highshelf），插在 AGC 后编码前。噪声门：AudioWorklet 实现（可调 RMS 门限）。电平表：AnalyserNode，手机端显示并每 500ms 广播到仪表盘。设置面板 localStorage 持久化（AGC/EQ/噪声门/回声消除开关）
features.evidence: Implemented + emulator-verified (2026-11-14). Capture graph rebuilt: mic → [noise gate AudioWorklet (public/gate-worklet.js, RMS + 250ms hold, k-rate threshold)] → [AGC compressor, toggleable] → [EQ: fixed 80Hz highpass + lowshelf(200Hz)/highshelf(4kHz) gains] → analyser tap → dest; each stage toggleable. Settings panel (⚙ on phone): mic picker (enumerateDevices, stale-deviceId fallback to default on NotFound), echo-cancel/AGC/EQ/gate toggles, bass/treble/gate-threshold sliders with LIVE setTargetAtTime while streaming, persisted in localStorage (darkmic-settings) — verified: toggles/bass=3 survived full page reload. Level meter: AnalyserNode RMS every 500ms → phone bar + dB display (clamped -99..0) + {type:'level'} WS broadcast → server relay (src/index.ts) → dashboard 5th metric (LEVEL dBFS + mini bar, pc.html). Emulator evidence: settings UI interacted via adb (screenshots), persistence across reload, streaming with EQ+gate enabled E2E PASS 1820 chunks (AudioWorklet loads clean), level broadcast captured by host WS client at 500ms cadence (12 msgs/6s). Local: typecheck+build clean, vitest 24/24, JS syntax checks. PENDING_REAL_DEVICE_TEST: audible EQ/gate effect on real voice, level meter behavior with real mic input, multi-mic device switching, gate threshold tuning by ear.

features.name: Real E2E latency measurement + monitoring
features.nameZh: 真实端到端延迟测量 + 监控增强
features.description: Phase 4 of the 2026-11-14 roadmap. Replace the WS RTT/2 approximation with real audio-path latency (send timestamps attached per chunk, aligned at decode time); dashboard distinguishes signaling RTT vs audio latency. New dashboard metrics: jitter (arrival interval variance), bitrate history graph (canvas), buffer watermark (wasapi accumulator via WasapiOutput.stats()). Mute button (phone ↔ dashboard messages) + PC speaker monitoring (tap output reusing ffplay mode capability).
features.descriptionZh: 2026-11-14 路线图 Phase 4。用真实音频链路延迟替换 WS RTT/2 近似（编码帧附发送时间戳，解码时刻对齐计算）；仪表盘区分信令 RTT 与音频延迟。新增指标：抖动（到达间隔方差）、码率历史曲线（canvas）、缓冲水位（wasapi 累积器，经 WasapiOutput.stats()）。静音按钮（手机 ↔ 仪表盘互发消息）+ PC 扬声器监听（复用 ffplay 模式能力做 tap 输出）

features.name: Latency tuning + WebRTC decision gate
features.nameZh: 延迟优化 + WebRTC 决策门
features.description: Phase 5 of the 2026-11-14 roadmap. Based on F-012 real measurements: wasapi buffer 6×50ms → adaptive (target 100-150ms upper bound); opus frameDuration tuning (10ms→5ms trial) and bitrate probe up to 96kbps. Decision gate: if measured end-to-end latency still >100ms, implement F-006 (werift + RTCPeerConnection, WS signaling only, phone stays browser-only); otherwise close F-006 as not-needed.
features.descriptionZh: 2026-11-14 路线图 Phase 5。基于 F-012 的真实数据：wasapi 缓冲 6×50ms → 自适应（目标 100-150ms 上限）；opus frameDuration 调优（10ms→5ms 试验）与码率上探 96kbps。决策门：实测端到端延迟仍 >100ms 则实施 F-006（werift + RTCPeerConnection，WS 仅信令，手机端保持纯浏览器）；否则关闭 F-006 标记为不需要

features.name: AI noise reduction via WASM (browser-side)
features.nameZh: 浏览器端 AI 降噪（WASM）
features.description: Phase 6 of the 2026-11-14 roadmap — differentiator highlight vs MicYou's native AI denoising. WASM RNNoise (~1MB, <10ms inference per frame, mobile-friendly) running in a phone-side AudioWorklet as an optional node before the EQ chain. Traditional NS (getUserMedia built-in) vs AI denoising comparable via toggles. Weak-device detection (decoder performance probe) with graceful degradation hint.
features.descriptionZh: 2026-11-14 路线图 Phase 6——对标 MicYou 原生 AI 降噪的差异化亮点。WASM RNNoise（约 1MB，每帧推理 <10ms，适合移动端）跑在手机端 AudioWorklet，作为 EQ 链前置的可开关节点。传统 NS（getUserMedia 自带）与 AI 降噪可对比开关。弱设备检测（性能探针）自动降级提示

features.name: Rust audio-engine evaluation (output adapter first)
features.nameZh: Rust 音频引擎评估（输出适配器优先）
features.description: Parallel low-priority evaluation workstream from the autonomous engineering charter §3/§8 (decisions D-003); roadmap F-008–F-014 remains the main line. Priority correction vs charter §8: first Rust target is the audio OUTPUT adapter, not opus decode — opusscript decode has no measured bottleneck (48kHz mono, single connection, sub-ms per frame), so migrating it would fail the charter's own migration rule §3.5. Slice 1: ~100-line Rust prototype (CPAL) consuming s16le PCM on stdin → BlackHole (macOS), reusing the proven ffplay stdin-pipe pattern (src/audio.ts), benchmarked against ffplay mode per charter §8 (latency/CPU/memory, hardware + conditions documented). Rust owns output adapters; TypeScript keeps opus decode (avoids libopus C cross-compile risk from macOS ARM). Option A (stdin/IPC subprocess) vs Option B (N-API) compared before any commitment; Windows cross-compile and packaging complexity (single-exe trade-off) are explicit benchmark dimensions. Retain TypeScript wherever measurable benefit is absent.
features.descriptionZh: 自主工程章程 §3/§8 的并行低优先级评估工作流（决策 D-003）；主线不变：F-008–F-014。对章程 §8 的优先级修正：Rust 首个落点为音频输出适配器而非 opus 解码——opusscript 解码无实测瓶颈（48kHz 单声道、单连接、每帧亚毫秒），迁移它过不了章程自己的迁移规则 §3.5。切片 1：约 100 行 Rust 原型（CPAL），从 stdin 消费 s16le PCM → BlackHole（macOS），复用已验证的 ffplay stdin 管道模式（src/audio.ts），按章程 §8 与 ffplay 模式基准对比（延迟/CPU/内存，记录硬件与条件）。Rust 负责输出适配器，TypeScript 保留 opus 解码（规避从 macOS ARM 交叉编译 libopus C 依赖的风险）。选型前先做 Option A（stdin/IPC 子进程）与 Option B（N-API）对比；Windows 交叉编译与打包复杂度（单 exe 取舍）作为显式基准维度。无实测收益则保留 TypeScript。
